step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows mobile edge nodes (Supernodes) connecting to AWS EKS to manage discovery and mesh registration, persisting metadata in MongoDB and DynamoDB. Edge nodes send logs to Kinesis Data Streams, routed through Kinesis Firehose to Amazon S3, where Snowflake queries data for analytics.
